entries.headline: U.S. spy and nuclear-command aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a U.S. Air Force surveillance aircraft and two nuclear-command jets airborne over the continental United States, along with 21 coded radio broadcasts recorded that day.

entries.headline: Kawasaki P-1 sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Kawasaki P-1 with no call sign, registration 5518 and hex code 87C841. The sighting was credited to truthseekr60.

entries.headline: RFF740 evacuation report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a contributor report that Russia evacuated nuclear scientists from Iran aboard flight RFF740, and that the flight departed Iran with its transponder off.

entries.headline: Potential Iran strike warning reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a contributor report that Washington alerted Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Faleh al Zaidi to a potential strike on Iran.

entries.headline: UK emergency-preparedness guidance highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Independent report that UK households were urged to prepare for emergencies and attacks under new government guidance.

entries.headline: U.S. transport and command aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and North Sea, including one nuclear command jet.

entries.headline: Russian Tu-134AK departure from Mehrabad reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a contributor report that a Russian Special Flight Squadron Tupolev Tu-134AK was seen departing Mehrabad International Airport in Iran.

entries.headline: Denmark ammunition transfer to Ukraine highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Ukrainska Pravda report that Denmark expedited the transfer of more than 50,000 20 mm rounds to Ukraine for F-16s, and noted that two outlets later confirmed the report.

entries.headline: U.S. transport and radar aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and an airborne radar jet flying, with multiple refuelling tankers and cargo aircraft crossing the Atlantic.

entries.headline: Judea Junction shooting follow-up highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an IDF follow-up about a reported shooting attack in the Judea Junction area and noted that three outlets later confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Shooting attack near Judea Junction reported
entries.summary: War Watch said the IDF issued an initial report of a shooting attack near Judea Junction 26 minutes before wire coverage, and noted that two outlets later confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Elevated coded radio broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported U.S. Air Force coded radio broadcasts running nearly 3.4 times above normal across nine regions from the Pacific to the North Sea, with ten broadcasts recorded that day.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: BACE Thursday traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity up 10% while overall Las Vegas valley traffic fell 3% on Thursday compared with Wednesday, and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: Las Vegas field departure count reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 243 aircraft still on the ground across four Las Vegas fields at 10:16 a.m. ET Friday, with 61 already departed.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE peak-hour replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay covering 28 minutes of Wednesday’s NBAA-BACE peak traffic across Harry Reid, Henderson, North Las Vegas and Boulder City, followed by a valley-wide view.

entries.headline: N871CB Boulder City arrival replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared the Wednesday NBAA-BACE arrival of Citation CJ2 N871CB into Boulder City, showing the approach at ten-times speed and the touchdown in real time.

entries.headline: Henderson NBAA-BACE business-jet traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 81 business jets at Henderson on Wednesday during NBAA-BACE, compared with 172 at Harry Reid, highlighting overflow traffic handled by the valley’s reliever airfields.

entries.headline: Las Vegas NBAA-BACE traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported Las Vegas business-jet activity up 13% on Wednesday during NBAA-BACE while overall traffic eased by about 5%, citing SkyGlass MCP data.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE departure surge reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 360 departures across four Las Vegas-area airfields by mid-afternoon Wednesday following NBAA-BACE, including 148 departures from Harry Reid International Airport.

entries.headline: N333QS North Las Vegas arrival replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a one-take replay of N333QS, a Phenom 300, flying from Van Nuys to North Las Vegas and continuing from the valley to touchdown and back.

entries.headline: Harry Reid ramp aircraft counts shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 38 aircraft on one Harry Reid ramp and 26 on another on Wednesday morning during NBAA-BACE, shown in four frames from the valley to the ramp.

entries.headline: KLAS show-week ramp tour shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a continuous tour of the KLAS ramp, noting that show-week ground activity becomes difficult after aircraft land.

entries.headline: Las Vegas Strip helicopter replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 120-times-speed replay of Tuesday evening helicopter tours operating from Harry Reid International Airport, along the Las Vegas Strip and back.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE day-one peak replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay of NBAA-BACE day-one peak traffic covering KLAS, KHND, KVGT and KBVU, followed by a whole-valley view.
